title: Lear's soul-catcher-on-the-moon theory
summary: Jeremy Corbell tells of Lear's soul-catcher-on-the-moon theory, about unspecified at The Moon, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: The Grays were controlling the soul sucker on the moon and when you die it sucks up your soul and it gets reprocessed unless the Grays steal it.

plain: A filmmaker, Jeremy Corbell, describes an idea held by a pilot named John Lear about a "soul catcher" on the Moon. As Corbell tells it, the Grays, grey-skinned aliens of popular lore, controlled this device, which sucks up your soul when you die so it can be reprocessed, unless the Grays steal it first. The theory, which Corbell mentions alongside Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft, would mean death itself is managed by non-humans.
